children: Dilip Buildcon share price rose 4 percent in the early trade on November 20 after receiving a Letter of Acceptance (LoA) worth Rs 419.47 crore from Gurugram Metro Rail Limited (GMRL) for the construction of a depot-cum-workshop at Sector 33, Gurugram.
At 09:21am, Dilip Buildcon was quoting at Rs 401.65, up Rs 15.50, or 4.01 percent, on the BSE.
The project includes civil, architectural and electrical and mechanical (E&M) works for the elevated Gurugram Metro corridor and is to be completed within 21 months.
Catch all the market action on our live blog
Separately, Anand Rathi upgraded the stock to 'Buy' from its earlier rating and raised the target price to Rs 535 in a report dated November 14.

However, the company reported a 52.7 percent year-on-year decline in consolidated Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 101.3 crore, compared with Rs 214.1 crore a year ago. Revenue increased 16.8 percent to Rs 2,250.4 crore from Rs 1,925.9 crore.
In the previous trading session, the share closed at Rs 386.15, up Rs 0.85, or 0.22 percent.
The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 496.15 and a 52-week low of Rs 354.00 on 11 May, 2026 and 23 October, 2026, respectively.
Currently, the stock is trading 22.16 percent below its 52-week high and 9.1 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the company stands at Rs 6,272.81 crore.

title: Dilip Buildcon share price rises 4% on Rs 419.47 crore order win
